entries.name: Understanding evidence
entries.patient: A classical reference documents traditional use; it does not by itself establish that a treatment works or is safe.
entries.doctor: Evaluate study design, population, comparator, outcomes, adverse events and certainty independently of textual authority.
entries.student: Distinguish textual provenance from clinical efficacy and safety.

entries.name: When to seek urgent medical care
entries.patient: Do not delay emergency medical care for chest pain, severe breathing difficulty, stroke symptoms or loss of consciousness.
entries.doctor: Prioritize emergency assessment and referral over traditional interventions.
entries.student: Recognize red flags and escalation pathways.
